decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's waste-to-energy core, and the website gives no sign it gained traction after 2019, so with many other technology options competing for resources its option value looks unlikely to justify further commitment.

Modular plant extensions cost little to carry because they complement the core waste-to-energy plants, and their value is still uncertain as decentralized deployments grow, so the option is worth keeping.

The waste oil to energy plant is a core offering that had its own page and a dedicated launch announcement, and the market for decentralized waste-oil solutions is still unfolding, so keeping the option open is justified.
The plastic waste to fuel plant was promoted to its own page in 2019 and addresses a large, growing problem, so its upside remains unresolved and worth keeping within the firm's strategic focus.
